title: Flat scalar units in tensor and section presentations
statement: Let a:R→S be a morphism of commutative condensed ring objects whose scalar extensions on schemes preserve finite limits. For a scheme T, let e be a TensorNormalization with TensorNormalized, and q:R_T→Res(S_T) a regular-module map whose underlying sheaf map is a_T. The specified scalar adjunction unit, followed by e, is the inverse right unitor followed by tensoring with Q(q[0]). There is a SectionScalarComparison s which is SectionScalarNormalized and SectionTensorNormalized with e, and its fixed derived restriction and extension comparisons carry the internal scalar unit to s.pair.adjunction.unit. All objects and normalization predicates are those of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons], [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data], [def-sfb-section-scalar-tensor-normalization-data], and [def-pd-section-derived-realization].

proof.text: The ordinary scalar unit inserts 1 before the balanced quotient; the specified ordinary tensor comparison sends s tensor m to m tensor s, hence carries it to inverse right unitor followed by tensoring with q.

Derive the exact scalar functors termwise. Use the normalized adjunction computation formula, then cancel the tensor localization map with the flat coefficient in degree zero. This proves the internal unit equation for all unbounded objects.

Apply internal scalar pullback normalization to the identity of T. The obtained tensor normalization agrees with e by cancellation of the flat-coefficient tensor computation map. The local generator formula preserves the ordinary scalar unit. The normalized internal/section scalar Hom comparison, first on flat-term K-flat models and then by localization, identifies the specified derived units.

theorem flat_scalar_unit_normalization (T : Scheme.{u})
    (e : TensorNormalization a T) (he : TensorNormalized a T e)
    (q : Mod.regular (condensedRingObj R T) ⟶ B₀ a T)
    (hq : q.hom = coefficientMap a T) :
    (∀ M : DerivedCategory (Modules R T),
      (scalarAdj a T).unit.app M ≫ e.derived.hom.app M =
        (ρ_ M).inv ≫ M ◁ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (Modules R T) 0).map q)) ∧
    ∃ s : SectionScalarComparison a T,
      SectionScalarNormalized a T s ∧ SectionTensorNormalized a T s e ∧
      ∀ M : DerivedCategory (Modules R T),
        (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence R T).functor.map
            ((scalarAdj a T).unit.app M) ≫
          (sectionScalarRestriction a T s).hom.app ((D a T).obj M) ≫
          (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
            (CategoryTheory.InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
              (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T))).map
                (s.derived.hom.app M) =
        s.pair.adjunction.unit.app
          ((ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence R T).functor.obj M)
